Finding.description: A single structured issue discovered during a scan.

FindingCategory.description: Taxonomy bucket for analytics, dashboards, and policy routing.

FindingCode.description:
Machine-facing finding code with enforced namespace policy.

Allowed forms:
- `system.<domain>.<name>[.<sub>...]` — at least three dot segments after `system`.
- `plugin.<plugin_id>.<name>[.<sub>...]` — `plugin_id` must be `[a-z0-9_-]+`.
- `user.<name>[.<sub>...]` — at least two segments total.

FindingFingerprint.description: Dedupe-friendly fingerprint derived from stable finding fields.

FindingLocation.description: Where a finding applies within a dataset surface.

FindingSeverity.description: Severity guides triage ordering; it is not a substitute for human judgment.

GroupingKind.description: How the engine grouped files into a logical Parquet dataset (co-location / inference signal).

InspectionStatus.description: Terminal state of format-specific inspection for one discovered asset.

JobErrorCode.description: Machine-readable job failure class (parallel to HTTP `AppError` codes where applicable).

JobKind.description: Durable application job kind (v0.7 generic job model).

JobStatus.description: Job lifecycle state persisted in SQLite and returned over HTTP.

policy_toml.description: Optional repair policy TOML; default policy when omitted.

target_schema_path.description: Optional JSON file containing target schema field descriptors.

ProbeMetadata.description: Bounded shallow-text probe limits and honesty signals.

bytes_sampled.description: Bytes actually read from disk for this probe (may be less than file size).

encoding_assumption.description: Character decoding policy applied to sampled bytes.

notes.description: Human notes (for example NDJSON first-record-only semantics).

probe_depth.description: Whether the probe covered the whole file within the cap or only a prefix.

ReportFormatVersion.description: Newtype wrapper for report format version strings.

RunDiff.description: First-class diff between two materialized reports (deterministic ordering).

RunId.description: Stable identifier for one persisted scan execution (distinct from `ScanRequest.scan_id`).

RunOutcome.description: High-level completion status for a stored run.

attempt_count.description: Monotonic claim count for this job (each dequeue from `queued` increments).

ScanMode.description: How a scan should treat incremental state (placeholder for later phases).

ScanOptions.description: Tunables that influence engine behavior without changing the target identity.

format_hints.description: Optional hint to restrict detection to a subset of formats.

max_files.description: Maximum files to enumerate in this scan (safety valve).

assets.description: Per-asset inspection outcomes (execution truth); reconcile with `summary`.

dataset_count.description: Logical Parquet datasets inferred for this scan.

info.description: PARQONAUT HTTP API for scan jobs, persisted runs, diffing, and bearer-token administration. Successful JSON responses and application-level errors use the `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }` envelope for failures. JSON request bodies use a shared extractor so malformed JSON, wrong JSON shape, missing `Content-Type: application/json`, and related body-buffer failures map to `invalid_json_request` with appropriate HTTP status codes (`400`, `415`, `422`, `413` where applicable).
